title: Discarded or Unreachable? Diagnosing and Repairing Spatial Relation Failure in Vision--Language Similarity
abstract: arXiv:2611.05565v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models score left/right relations near chance, but the symptom has two causes that call for opposite repairs: the relation may survive in the pooled embedding yet be unreachable by native image-text similarity, or pooling may discard it while the dense features retain it. On clean two object photographs, across ten encoders, the lateral polarity is linearly decodable from the flip odd component of the pooled vector at 0.77-0.99, yet a search over a million captions leaves nine of the ten at chance under native scoring: an access failure. On controlled C4 orbits, where the relation is the only thing that varies, pooling keeps the arrangement axis at 0.998-1.000 and loses its polarity, which the patch grid retains: a pooling failure. Both sit downstream of the dense features, so one readout covers both. Our zero parameter, query conditioned spatial moment recomputes the geometry from the patch grid and stores

translated_title: 被丢弃还是不可触及？诊断与修复视觉-语言相似性中的空间关系失效
translated_abstract: 对比式视觉-语言模型对左/右空间关系的评分接近随机水平，但这一症状有两种成因，需要截然相反的修复方式：空间关系可能仍保留在池化后的嵌入中，却无法通过原生图文相似度触及；或者池化过程丢弃了这一关系，而密集特征仍保留着它。在干净的双物体照片上，跨十个编码器，横向极性可以从池化向量的翻转奇分量中以0.77-0.99的准确率被线性解码，然而在对一百万条描述的搜索中，十个编码器中有九个在原生评分下仍处于随机水平：这是访问失败。在受控的C4轨道（其中空间关系是唯一变化量）上，池化以0.998-1.000的准确率保留了排列轴却丢失了其极性，而patch网格保留了极性：这是池化失败。两者都位于密集特征的下游，因此单一的读取机制即可同时覆盖两类失败。我们的零参数、查询条件化空间矩方法从patch网格重新计算几何信息并存储……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了对比视觉-语言模型在左右空间关系判断上的失效存在两种成因——关系信息可被解码但相似度搜索无法触及的“访问失败”，以及池化丢弃信息而密集特征保留的“池化失败”，并提出一种零参数、查询条件化的空间矩方法从patch网格重新计算几何信息，用一个读取机制统一修复两类失败。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that contrastive vision-language models fail at left/right spatial relations for two distinct causes—an access failure where the relation is linearly decodable but unreachable by native similarity scoring, and a pooling failure where pooling discards polarity retained in the patch grid—and repairs both with a zero-parameter, query-conditioned spatial moment recomputed from the patch grid.
